{{Quote|The dark side is always at hand, Padawan.|Luminara Unduli to Barris Offee as the two stood under a blackneedle tree|<ref name="MSIBS" />}}
The '''blackneedle tree''' was a type of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] that grew in [[Oa Park]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="MSIBS" /> The tree growing in the park was planted by [[420 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the main events of ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'' to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. The blackneedle [[Tree/Legends|tree]] is four hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of its appearance in ''Battle Surgeons''. Therefore, the tree must have been planted by [[420 BBY]].</ref> Sometime before [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] fought with the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Phow Ji]] on the planet [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]]<ref name="MSIBS" /> in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> she and her master, [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]], stood in the shade of one such tree that was three [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in diameter, 200 meters tall, and over 400 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old.<ref name="MSIBS" />

There, Unduli warned her Padawan that the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] was always a threat, against which she should be vigilant. On the night after her fight with Ji, which had tempted Offee to use the dark side, she remembered her [[Time/Legends|time]] with Unduli in the park, including the interaction in the blackneedle's shade.<ref name="MSIBS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The blackneedle tree was mentioned in the [[2004]] novel ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'', which was written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]] as the first book in the [[MedStar Duology]].<ref name="MSIBS" />
